issue_context.title: Update cli-runtime to Kustomize v5
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

Please update the Kustomize packages in cli-runtime to  `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api@v0.13.1` and `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/kyaml@v0.14.0`. Every project that imports both `cli-runtime` and the new `kustomize/api` result in compilation error due to the removal of `DoLegacyResourceSort` which is used in cli-runtime here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/cli-runtime/pkg/resource/kustomizevisitor.go#L41.

Bumping `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api` to `v0.13.1` results in:

```
# k8s.io/cli-runtime/pkg/resource
../../../../pkg/mod/k8s.io/cli-runtime@v0.26.1/pkg/resource/kustomizevisitor.go:41:8:
kOpts.DoLegacyResourceSort undefined (type *krusty.Options has no field or method DoLegacyResourceSort)
```

This issue blocks us from shipping the new features in Kustomize to Flux users, ref: https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/issues/3564

### What did you expect to happen?

I would expect for the Kustomize API to no ship breaking changes in a minor release, the `DoLegacyResourceSort` was available in `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api@v0.12.1`  but removed in `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api@v0.13.1`. I really wish Kubernetes would not depend on Kustomize packages...

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Bump `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api` to `v0.13.1` and run `go vet`.

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_

> probably so, but @natasha41575 might know better if there were behavior or code changes that would make it non-trivial for Kubernetes to update

You can find [detailed release notes here](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/releases/tag/api%2Fv0.13.0). I don't know of any reason that would make it nontrivial to update.

> `sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api` is still v0 series (alpha), so there are no "major" releases, and there can and will be breaking changes in "minor" releases.

Specifically, changes in the go API are expected. Behavior changes of invoking `kustomize` against an existing kustomization.yaml file are expected to be backwards compatible.
